title: Well data decoding tests the wrong decimal for token one
rootCause: Stable2.decodeWellData tests decimal0 twice, so token one's zero is never replaced by 18, and when decimal0 is zero a real value for token one is overwritten with 18. Every scaling that follows uses the wrong decimals.

poc.observable: test_token_one_decimals_are_read_from_their_own_value fails with "a zero for token one means 18: 0 != 18"
